short: The electronic permit needed to move goods above a threshold value.
seoTitle: E-Way Bill — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: An e-way bill is an electronically generated document required for moving consignments of goods above a specified value.
definition: An e-way bill is an electronically generated document required for moving consignments of goods above a specified value. It carries a unique number along with the invoice, transporter and vehicle details, and must accompany the goods in transit.
bodyHtml:
Why E-Way Bill matters

Goods stopped in transit without a valid e-way bill can be detained and penalised, and the penalty usually lands on the consignment owner rather than the transporter.

How E-Way Bill works in practice

Generate the bill from the invoice data before dispatch, and update the vehicle details if the consignment changes trucks mid-route. Each e-way bill also has a validity period tied to the distance to be covered.

faq.question: Is an e-way bill needed for every delivery?
faq.answer: No. It applies above a consignment value threshold, with exemptions for certain goods and short local movements.

faq.question: Who generates the e-way bill?
faq.answer: Usually the supplier, but the recipient or the transporter can generate it depending on who arranges the movement.
